schema_url.title: Public OpenAPI JSON / YAML URL
schema_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to an OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 JSON/YAML schema (used when inline schema is empty)

schema.title: Inline OpenAPI JSON / YAML Schema
schema.description: Optional raw OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON or YAML string (overrides schema_url when provided)

instructions.title: Custom GPT Instructions
instructions.description: Optional Custom GPT system instructions embedded into the generated SKILL.md

auth_type.title: Upstream Auth Mode
auth_type.description: Authentication scheme for the generated Cloudflare MCP server

auth_header.title: Custom Auth Header Name
auth_header.description: Optional header name when auth_type is api_key_header (default X-API-Key)

include_zip.title: Generate bundle.zip Archive
include_zip.description: Save a ready-to-deploy bundle.zip into the run Key-Value Store
